parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: Group 2 carbonates decompose when heated to form the metal oxide and carbon dioxide.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Describe the variation in the thermal stability of Group 2 carbonates. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The lattice energy of the Group 2 carbonates, $\Delta H_{latt}^{\ominus}(\text{MCO}_3)$, becomes less exothermic down the group.

The lattice energy of the Group 2 oxides, $\Delta H_{latt}^{\ominus}(\text{MO})$, also becomes less exothermic down the group.

$\Delta H_{latt}^{\ominus}(\text{MCO}_3)$ and $\Delta H_{latt}^{\ominus}(\text{MO})$ change by different amounts going down the group.

Suggest how the standard enthalpy change of the decomposition reaction for Group 2 carbonates changes down the group.

Explain your reasoning in terms of the relative sizes of the anions and the relative changes in lattice energy down the group.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Potassium sulfite, $\text{K}_2\text{SO}_3$, is used as a food additive.

The concentration of sulfite ions, $\text{SO}_3^{2-}$, can be determined by titration using aqueous acidified manganate(VII) ions, $\text{MnO}_4^{-}$.

- A $250\text{ cm}^3$ solution contains $3.40\text{ g}$ of impure $\text{K}_2\text{SO}_3$.
- $25.0\text{ cm}^3$ of this solution requires $22.40\text{ cm}^3$ of $0.0250\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ acidified $\text{MnO}_4^{-}$ to reach the end-point. All the $\text{SO}_3^{2-}$ ions are oxidised. None of the other species in the impure $\text{K}_2\text{SO}_3$ are oxidised.

The reaction occurs as shown by the two half-equations.

$$\text{H}_2\text{O} + \text{SO}_3^{2-} \rightarrow \text{SO}_4^{2-} + 2\text{H}^{+} + 2\text{e}^{-}$$

$$\text{MnO}_4^{-} + 8\text{H}^{+} + 5\text{e}^{-} \rightarrow \text{Mn}^{2+} + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}$$
parts.text: Give the ionic equation for the reaction between $\text{SO}_3^{2-}$ and acidified $\text{MnO}_4^{-}$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the percentage purity of the sample of $\text{K}_2\text{SO}_3$. Show your working.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Deduce the geometry (shape) around the $\text{S}(\alpha)$ atom in $\text{S}_2\text{O}_5^{2-}$.
